scope: OS foundations, native user-space tools, module contracts, deployment planning, service interfaces and the Mora desktop boundary. Browser-shell preferences are not kernel enforcement.

status_policy.rule: Use implemented or partial only when repository code and focused verification paths support the exact statement. Record limits explicitly. A design document, capability catalog or profile-validation job does not prove runtime behavior.

controls.title: Module boundaries and versioned contracts
controls.assessment: A native module ABI and foundation architecture are present; the current kernel/service boundaries still include declarative Reaper-language components and are not a complete running kernel contract.
limitations: The ABI is a user-space integration contract; do not infer complete kernel isolation or service enforcement.

controls.title: Input validation and idempotent state changes
controls.assessment: Deployment plans and versioned manifests use explicit validation and tests; system-wide idempotent servicing is not claimed.
limitations: Planning and archive verification do not perform privileged installation or prove crash-safe OS updates.

controls.title: Low-level I/O and transport boundaries
controls.assessment: IPC and zero-copy bus source files exist, but the repository has not established an executing native kernel transport or a production network stack.
limitations: RPR source declarations are not evidence of an operational transport; do not claim network-server readiness.

controls.title: Concurrency, scheduling and backpressure
controls.assessment: A scheduler source module is present, but bounded runtime scheduling, queue backpressure and contention behavior have not been verified as a running kernel subsystem.
limitations: No kernel load, saturation, race or recovery test currently establishes these behaviors.

controls.title: Memory ownership and resource lifetime
controls.assessment: Arena and memory subsystem source files exist; allocator ownership, reclamation, isolation and lifetime guarantees have not been independently verified.
limitations: Do not treat source presence as a working allocator or memory-protection boundary.

controls.title: Data integrity and transactions
controls.assessment: Versioned manifests, deterministic bundles and deployment plans have validation coverage; persistent system-state transactions and boot rollback are not claimed.
limitations: A deployment plan is not an atomic update engine or tested physical-disk recovery path.

controls.title: Failure handling, recovery and lifecycle
controls.assessment: Bundle verification and non-destructive deployment planning are covered by tests; graceful lifecycle and A/B boot recovery are still incomplete.
limitations: Do not present archive verification or an A/B plan as boot rollback or service-supervisor enforcement.

controls.title: Security, privileges and secret handling
controls.assessment: Mora capability preferences and native trust/capability source contracts exist; kernel-enforced per-process authorization and a complete secret service are not established.
limitations: Browser preferences and policy files are not OS privilege enforcement.

controls.title: Observability and diagnostics
controls.assessment: Read-only hardware inventory and diagnostic reporting are implemented; end-to-end kernel tracing and service latency telemetry are not established.
limitations: Hardware snapshots are not continuous monitoring or distributed tracing.

controls.title: Performance budgets and capacity
controls.assessment: No verified kernel throughput, latency distribution, queue-capacity or horizontal service-scaling baseline is currently recorded.
limitations: Do not infer performance or scalability from modular source layout or architecture plans.

controls.title: Configuration, extensibility and integration
controls.assessment: The module ABI and commit-pinned repository federation provide explicit extension and source-integration boundaries.
limitations: Federated source checkouts do not automatically load, execute or grant privileges to external modules.

controls.title: Verification and delivery gate
controls.assessment: This PR adds a machine-readable backend engineering profile, safe-path/status validator, negative self-tests and a dedicated CI gate.
limitations: The gate validates profile integrity and evidence paths; it does not certify OS readiness or runtime behavior.
